description: Cross-check |tr_M(β)| for D, T, ³He via two independent canonical paths: (1) Hoefsmit seminormal + Wedderburn sum via `wedderburn_jones_markov.global_wedderburn_sum_q_hecke_seminormal` (used in all six brane-tower n_⋆ probe families of PR #638); (2) Markov-axiom recursive ascent via `markov_peel.tr_M_atomic` (canonical reducer, no Hoefsmit matrices). Tests whether the ³He structural gap identified in the closure audit is a real brane-tower-formula deficit or a Markov-trace mis-count.
caveats: markov_peel.tr_M_atomic returns a SymbolicHeckeElement; we substitute q_0 and evalf at 30 dps then float64-cast. Any disagreement at 1e-10 reflects float64 cast + symbolic-evaluation rounding, not a structural mismatch.
